modules.label: Google Chrome
modules.description: Installs Chrome for this Windows user if it isn't on the computer yet. Does nothing if any Chrome is already installed. Leaves Chrome in place on uninstall.

modules.label: Desktop shortcut to a website
modules.description: Adds a desktop icon that opens one website, as an app window (no tabs or address bar) or a normal browser tab.

options.label: Shortcut name
options.hint: Shown under the desktop icon. Used as the downloaded file name too.

options.label: How the icon opens the site

values.label: App window (no tabs or address bar)

options.label: Icon (optional)
options.hint: .ico, .png, or .jpg. Leave blank to use Chrome's icon.

modules.label: Ad blocker for Chrome (uBlock Origin Lite)
modules.description: Force-installs uBlock Origin Lite via Chrome policy so it can't be accidentally disabled or removed.

options.label: Pin the ad-blocker icon to Chrome's toolbar so it's visible
Automatically close and reopen Chrome if it's already running (otherwise it takes effect the next time Chrome opens on its own)

modules.label: Chrome bookmarks (from another computer)
modules.description: Puts bookmarks you saved with Capture-Profile.cmd into Chrome. Bookmarks only: never passwords, cookies, history or sign-in. Chrome must be closed while this runs; an existing bookmark list is kept unless you tick the box below.

options.label: Bookmarks file saved by Capture-Profile.cmd
options.hint: Run Capture-Profile.cmd on the old computer; it puts Bookmarks-*.json files on the Desktop. Choose one here.

options.label: Replace the bookmarks Chrome already has (a copy is kept so uninstall can put them back)

modules.label: Test: secret option (CI only)
modules.description: Hidden test item. Stores only a fingerprint of the secret, to prove secrets reach the computer through the download's files folder and never appear in the setup file or its log.
